title: Why Bigard cannot recover back royalties on 'Mood Indigo'
summary: Willard asks why there is no retroactive money; Bigard says Mills and Ellington were already paid, that his name was missing for 28 years, and that he has thirteen tunes there.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: But there's no way -- I still don't understand why you can't get some kind of retroactive money for all the years your name wasn't on 'Mood Indigo'. Why not?
Because they've gotten the money already, that's why.
They done paid out to Mills and Ellington.
But there's still money being paid out to Mills and Ellington. They can't, like, take it out of their accounts now? That's a shame.
Uh-uh. And there's 20 years of it, too. 28 years. Can you imagine that? I wrote 13 tunes I got in there. Now I got -- I just wrote five tunes now. They're coming out on this record.
